description: Tests basement ceiling height, height under beams and ducts, and stair headroom against Ontario Building Code Part 9, for a house basement or a secondary suite. Window sizes are tested by the egress window size calculator. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/basement-ceiling-height-and-egress-checker?units=mm&type=suite&ceiling=2000&obstruction=1900&stair=1980

bedroom.description: house only: a bedroom is planned in the basement

bedroom_low.description: house with bedroom only: lowest ceiling in the bedroom (units)

bedroom_share.description: house with bedroom only: percent of the required bedroom floor area with a ceiling of 2,300 mm or more (%)

ceiling.description: Finished ceiling height over the main part of the space, floor to underside of the finished ceiling (units)

obstruction.description: Lowest clear height under a beam or duct (units)

share.description: house only: percent of the basement floor area with a ceiling of 2,100 mm or more (default 100 when the ceiling is 2,100 mm or more, otherwise 0) (%)

stair.description: Clear height over the basement stair, measured from the line through the tread nosings (units)

type.description: house = basement of a house without a secondary suite; suite = secondary suite

name: basement-ceiling-height-and-egress-checker
title: Basement ceiling height and egress checker
